hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/memory"; mkdir -p "$d/.sessions"; sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); date +%s > "$d/.sessions/$sid"; if [ -s "$d/UNCLOSED.md" ]; then jq -n --arg c "$(cat "$d/UNCLOSED.md")" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Previous session(s) ended without the memory close protocol:\n" + $c + "\nReconstruct any missing memory/ updates (check git log and recent file changes), then delete memory/UNCLOSED.md.")}}'; fi

d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/memory"; mkdir -p "$d"; sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); f="$d/.sessions/$sid"; start=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); rm -f "$f"; now=$(date +%s); cm=$(stat -f %m "$d/CHANGELOG.md" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$d/CHANGELOG.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$start" -gt 0 ] && [ $((now - start)) -ge 300 ] && [ "$cm" -lt "$start" ]; then echo "- $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') session $sid ended without close protocol" >> "$d/UNCLOSED.md"; fi
